    Coefficient duality for finite modules over a linear category #

    Pointwise coefficient duality turns a finite covariant module over C into a finite covariant module over Cᵒᵖ. Finite-dimensional biduality upgrades this construction to an anti-equivalence of finite module categories.

    LinearModuleCategory k

    Pointwise coefficient dual of a covariant module, regarded as a module over the opposite category.
